feedFoundation: You’re connected. Your looks arrive in the Feed phase.
wardrobeFoundation: You’re connected. Your wardrobe items arrive in the next phase.
unavailableBody: Check your internet connection, then try again.
missingSessionBody: The server did not provide private access. Check the personal account configuration on the server.
incompatibleBody: This app requires FORM contract 5. Version information is missing or the server uses a different version.
rejectedBody: The server rejected the request. Check the server configuration.
configurationRequiredBody: Set FORM_API_BASE_URL in the local environment file and restart the app.
dataStatusBody: This foundation shows connection and data status. The full view follows in a later phase.
wardrobeRefreshFailed: Refresh failed. Cached items remain available.
itemActionFailed: Action failed. Refresh the item and try again.
generationRefresh: Processing continues on the server. Refresh for the latest status.
generationFailed: The last image failed. You can request a new one.
deleteItemConfirm: This item will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
invalidColors: Enter 1–6 colors, each up to 32 characters.
generationExplanation: The new catalog image is adopted automatically. Older images remain available. Higher quality costs more.
wardrobeInvalidResponse: The wardrobe response could not be read. The server is reachable, but its item data is incompatible with this app.
feedInvalidResponse: The look data could not be read. The server is reachable, but the response does not match this app.
chooseSupportedCategory: Choose a supported category to save this legacy item.

intake.title: Add clothing
intake.intro: We recognize your clothes, you choose what goes into your wardrobe.
intake.uploadBody: A single piece or a whole outfit. A calm background helps with detection.
intake.cost: Analysis and catalog images are created automatically with OpenAI and incur costs. After you choose, everything continues in the background.
intake.offline: Drafts are saved on this device. Connect to upload, analyze, or save.
intake.permission: Allow camera or photo access in system settings, then try again.
intake.invalidPhoto: This photo could not be prepared. Choose a supported image under 25 MB.
intake.fileSize: Choose a photo no larger than 25 MB.
intake.failed: This step failed. Your draft is saved. Try again.
intake.discardBody: Remove this local draft and photo? Items already saved and server jobs remain.
intake.created: Item saved. Catalog image still pending.
intake.manual: No clothing was detected. Enter the item details to continue.
intake.restartRequired: Photo access is not available in this running build. Stop the app and launch a fresh build. Hot reload is not sufficient.
intake.localSaveFailed: The photo could not be saved on this device. Check free storage and try again.

feedEmptyWithSheet: Let FORM assemble your first outfit.
feedEmptyWithoutSheet: Set up your photo collage first so looks really look like you.
feedActionFailed: Action failed. Refresh the feed and try again.
lookFailedBody: Your pieces stay here. You can create the image again.
lookFailedModeration: OpenAI's image filter rejected this image. For try-ons, a different photo where you're fully dressed often helps.
lookDeleteConfirmBody: Delete permanently? The image disappears from your feed. Costs already incurred remain in statistics.
lookPlanningBody: Your pieces appear here once the look is assembled.
lookPlanningWithItems: These pieces are included. FORM adds the rest.
lookGeneratingBody: The worn image is being created.
lookFlatEmpty: The pieces in this look are no longer available.
lookVaryBody: A new look based on this one. The original stays in the feed.
lookUpgradeBody: The same look with more detail. The existing image serves as reference. Small variations are possible. The original stays in the feed.
lookReshootBody: The same pieces, photographed from another perspective. The original stays in the feed.
composerNoEligible: No pieces with catalog images yet.
composerNoEligibleBody: Once a piece has its catalog image, you can combine it here.
composerCompleteHelpUnframable: Only works when your pieces share one part of the body, like only tops or only shoes.
composerPreviewHint: We start with this. FORM adds the rest.
composerPieceHint: Tap a piece to remove it from the selection.
composerPreviewEmptyHint: Choose more pieces or let FORM combine for you.
lookPlanningEmpty: Your pieces appear here once the look is assembled.
composerTrayLabel: View {count} selected pieces as flat lay
composerLimit: A look can start from up to 12 pieces.
lookPhotosDenied: FORM needs access to Photos to save images. You can allow it in Settings.
lookImageUnavailable: The image could not be loaded.
lookFlatMissingPieces: Pieces from your wardrobe are missing for this flat lay.
composerQualityNote: Choose directly for this look. Higher quality costs more.
composerTryOnHint: A full-body photo of you. The pieces are put on it 1:1. Use the same photo to compare try-ons.
tryOnAgainBody: The same pieces on you once more. The original stays in the feed.

character.title: Character references
character.subtitle: Your likeness for personal looks.
character.introBody: Choose one to four photos of the same person, ideally showing their face and full body. Then crop each photo and review the collage.
character.cropBody: Drag the photo into the frame and zoom in on your face or body. Everything inside the frame goes into the collage.
character.resolution: This crop will be enlarged and may look blurry. Zoom out or choose a sharper photo.
character.reviewBody: These photo crops are used unchanged as the reference for new looks. The collage itself has no AI costs.
character.noteLimit: The note can contain up to 1,000 characters.
character.retryLocked: Submission has started. Retry the same action to save this collage safely.
character.saved: Your photo collage is now used as your reference.
character.discardBody: Remove this local draft and its photos? References already saved on the server remain.
character.offline: Cached references remain available. Connect to save changes.
character.failed: The action failed. Please try again.
character.incompatible: The character reference response is incompatible with this app.
character.activeTitle: How you look in your outfits.
character.storedBody: A saved version of your reference.
character.historyBody: Choose a reference to view it.
character.missing: This character reference is no longer available.
character.deleteBody: Remove this version permanently? It disappears from Settings and cannot be reactivated. Existing looks and historical costs remain.
character.activeDelete: The active reference cannot be deleted.
character.pendingDelete: A reference that is being created cannot be deleted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.qualityBody: Default for new images on this device. Higher quality costs more. You can recreate individual images in higher quality later.
settings.cacheConfirmBody: Photos saved on this device are removed and download again when you need them. Drafts and unfinished uploads stay.
settings.resetBody: Clears the shared private wardrobe on all your devices. Clothing, photos, looks, and character references are permanently deleted.
settings.resetOffline: Connect to the internet to empty your wardrobe.
settings.resetSheetBody: All items, photos, and image drafts in your private wardrobe are deleted — on your other devices too.
settings.resetFailed: The wardrobe could not be emptied. Try again.

apiErrors.activeCharacterSheet: The active character reference cannot be deleted.
apiErrors.assetContentMissing: The image file is missing on the server.
apiErrors.assetNotFound: The image is no longer available.
apiErrors.characterSheetProcessing: A reference that is being created cannot be deleted.
apiErrors.generationInProgress: Wait until the current image processing finishes.
apiErrors.idempotencyKeyReused: This action was already submitted with different data. Refresh and try again.
apiErrors.invalidCharacterSheet: Save a photo collage as your reference.
apiErrors.invalidKeepRequest: Refresh the item and try again.
apiErrors.invalidLook: Check the selected pieces and categories.
apiErrors.invalidPermanentDeletion: Refresh the item and try again.
apiErrors.invalidRejectRequest: Refresh the item and try again.
apiErrors.invalidRestoreRequest: Refresh the item and try again.
apiErrors.invalidSignInRequest: Enter a valid email and password.
apiErrors.invalidWardrobeTransition: This change is not allowed for the item’s current state.
apiErrors.originNotAllowed: This app is not allowed to access the server from here.
apiErrors.resetInProgress: The wardrobe is being emptied right now.
apiErrors.sourcePhotoNotFound: The source photo is no longer available.
apiErrors.staleRecordVersion: The item changed on the server. Refresh and try again.
apiErrors.uploadIntentNotFound: The upload expired. Start the upload again.
apiErrors.uploadMissing: The upload is incomplete. Try the upload again.
apiErrors.wardrobeItemNotFound: This wardrobe item is no longer available.
apiErrors.insufficientCredits: Not enough credits for this generation.
apiErrors.tooManyActiveJobs: Several generations are already running. Wait until one finishes.
apiErrors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
apiErrors.invalidIdentityToken: Sign-in was not accepted. Please try again.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Photograph your clothes once. FORM turns them into your wardrobe and puts together new looks, worn by you.
onboarding.wardrobeBody: Snap a single piece or a whole outfit. FORM finds each piece, names it and creates a clean catalog image.
onboarding.wardrobeToggle: Own it or want it? Your wish list lives right next to your wardrobe.
onboarding.scoreBody: Now you know what FORM can do for you, and what it can’t.

questions.outfit: … find several pieces in one photo?
questions.hidden: … see pieces that are hidden in the photo?
questions.perfect: … get every detail right the first time?

answers.outfit: A whole outfit works. A calm background helps.
answers.hidden: Covered or folded pieces need a photo of their own.
answers.worn: With your photo collage, looks really look like you.
answers.size: FORM knows category, colors and style. Add anything else as a note.
answers.perfect: AI images vary. Tell FORM what’s off and create a new one.
answers.free: Analysis and images run on OpenAI and cost a little. Settings shows your weekly costs.

onboarding.feedBody: In the Feed, FORM combines your pieces into looks. Laid out flat, and worn by you.
onboarding.feedHint: Tap pieces to build a look.
onboarding.collageBody: One to four photos of you, with face and full body. FORM uses this collage as your reference for every worn look. It stays on your server.
onboarding.collageLater: You can also do this later in Settings.
onboarding.finaleBody: Setting up takes a little work. It pays off with every piece you add.
onboarding.finaleTip: Tip: start with the pieces you wear most.

auth.title: Welcome to FORM
auth.body: Sign in to keep your wardrobe in sync across devices.
auth.deleteBody: Your wardrobe, photos, looks, and credits are permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
auth.deleteOffline: Connect to the internet to delete your account.

lookStyleHint.candid: Caught in a moment, no pose

feedWeights.title: What shapes your feed
feedWeights.body: Every heart makes a perspective more frequent. Tap one to hide or show it.
feedWeights.failed: The weighting could not be loaded.

credits.title: Credits left
credits.empty: Not enough for another look. Catalog images cost 1 credit, looks cost 2.
